content: Rust inference serving systems follow a layered architecture: API layer (gRPC+HTTP), inference engine (ort Session), and model resolution (S3/HF). Key patterns: wrap Session in Arc for shared access, separate pre/post-processing from inference, use axum State for shared inference engine. The orp crate provides a composable pipeline framework with pre-process, model, post-process stages built on the composable crate.
